market_summary: A synchronized macroeconomic news impulse at 13:30 UTC during the London-NY Overlap sparked aggressive intrabar upside volatility across FX, precious metals, US indices, and crypto. However, these impulsive moves are captured mid-bar (only ~6 minutes into the M15 candle) and have pushed prices into extreme +2 ATR overextensions or directly into major session resistance levels, with metals already leaving deep rejection wicks back to their session POCs. Furthermore, Cumulative Delta across the board either shows neutral volume support or notable bearish divergence against the intrabar pop. Strict quantitative execution rules dictate waiting for closed-bar structural confirmation rather than chasing mid-bar news spikes. All six assets are rated HOLD.

signals.rationale: Evaluating the 7 confluence factors: 1) VP context: Signal candle closed below VAL (price_vs_value_area: below_val, VAL 3884.20) and below POC (close_vs_poc: below, POC 3895.22). Live price at 3895.93 has rebounded inside the Value Area right to POC. 2) CVD: CVD is -4.68 with a BEARISH label and negative cvd_slope of -1.36, heavily diverging from the sharp intrabar pop. 3) Session: LONDON_NY_OVERLAP. 4) VWAP & EMA50: Signal candle closed well below VWAP (3899.74) and EMA50 (3896.12); the forming bar spiked to 3905.66 but was promptly rejected back below VWAP and sits at EMA50. 5) ATR band: Live price sits mid-channel near baseline (EMA20 3892.02) after the forming wick rejected off the upper ATR band (3904.38). 6) RVOL: Signal candle printed rvol_last 1.842 without yellow RVOL > 2.0 confirmation. 7) S/R: Intrabar wick swept above S/R 3887.45 and failed to hold above VWAP, leaving a long upper wick. With price returning directly to the POC fair-value magnet mid-bar amid bearish delta divergence, action is HOLD.
